analyst-open.about: empty store: does it find a planted mechanism on its own?

analyst-question.about: one open question whose answer is the x07-x11 interaction

notes.author: ideator
notes.text: x07 has a mean within-date IC of about 0.30 but it is very uneven across dates. What determines on which dates x07 predicts y and on which it does not? Check the date-constant features.

ideator-findings.about: true measured findings that hint at, but do not state, the x07-x11 interaction

notes.author: analyst
notes.text: x03 predicts y cross-sectionally: mean within-date rank IC 0.330 on dates 0-249 and 0.303 on dates 250-499. Stable.

notes.author: analyst
notes.text: x05 is strongly correlated with x03 (corr 0.857). In a pooled regression y ~ x03 + x05, the x05 coefficient is 0.002 and the x03 coefficient 0.356.

notes.author: analyst
notes.text: x07 has mean per-date IC 0.298 with y, but the per-date IC has sd 0.231: on 69% of dates it is above 0.2, on most of the rest it is near zero.

notes.author: analyst
notes.text: x11 is date-constant (same for all assets on a date), very persistent (lag-1 autocorr 0.93), and positive on 354 of the 500 training dates.

forecaster-idea.about: the correct mechanism handed over as an idea: measures implementation skill

notes.author: ideator
notes.text: Mechanism: y = a * (within-date rank of x03, standardized) + b * x07 * [x11 > 0] + c * (the asset's previous y) + noise. x07 matters only on dates where the date-constant x11 is positive; x05 is a noisy copy of x03 and adds nothing. Model: fit a, b, c by least squares on these three constructed features. Support: CV clearly above a plain linear model on all features. Contradiction: no gain from the x11 gate.
